主要内容: On June 19, 2013, MEDALLION FINANCIAL CORP filed an 8-K with the SEC. The filing included shareholder votes on the appointment of WeiserMazars LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm, with 19,065,002 votes for and 320,689 against. Additionally, shareholders approved a non-binding advisory resolution on executive compensation, with 10,224,889 votes for and 1,506,736 against. The report was signed by Larry D. Hall, Chief Financial Officer, on June 19, 2013.
